env.TEST_NOTES: Verify Cloud Agent and Cursor SDK workflows, iPhone and iPad layouts, chat composer, attachments, model and MCP controls, Settings, light mode, and dark mode.

asc-health.description: Verify ASC auth, app resolution, TestFlight groups, and the latest visible builds.

preflight.description: Run local checks before archiving a TestFlight build.

steps.name: repo_clean
steps.run: test -z "$(git status --short)" || { git status --short >&2; echo 'Working tree must be clean before release.' >&2; exit 1; }

testflight.description: Set an explicit build number, run checks, archive, upload, add What to Test notes, and distribute to TestFlight.

steps.name: require_build_number
steps.run: test -n "$BUILD_NUMBER" || { echo 'Pass BUILD_NUMBER, for example: asc workflow run testflight BUILD_NUMBER:12' >&2; exit 2; }

steps.name: test_notes
steps.run: if [ -n "$TEST_NOTES" ]; then asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds test-notes create --build-id "${steps.resolve_uploaded_build.BUILD_ID}" --locale "$LOCALE" --whats-new "$TEST_NOTES" || asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds test-notes update --build-id "${steps.resolve_uploaded_build.BUILD_ID}" --locale "$LOCALE" --whats-new "$TEST_NOTES"; else echo 'Skipping TestFlight notes because TEST_NOTES is empty.' >&2; fi

steps.name: distribute
steps.run: if [ -n "$TESTFLIGHT_GROUP_ID" ]; then asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds add-groups --build-id "${steps.resolve_uploaded_build.BUILD_ID}" --group "$TESTFLIGHT_GROUP_ID"; else echo 'Skipping TestFlight group distribution because TESTFLIGHT_GROUP_ID is empty.' >&2; fi

distribute-existing.description: Attach notes and distribute an already uploaded build by BUILD_ID or BUILD_NUMBER.

steps.name: require_build
steps.run: test -n "$BUILD_ID" -o -n "$BUILD_NUMBER" || { echo 'Pass BUILD_ID or BUILD_NUMBER, for example: asc workflow run distribute-existing BUILD_NUMBER:12' >&2; exit 2; }

steps.name: resolve_existing_build
steps.run: if [ -n "$BUILD_ID" ]; then asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds info --build-id "$BUILD_ID" --output json; else asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds info --app $APP_ID --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" --version "$VERSION" --platform IOS --output json; fi

steps.name: test_notes
steps.run: if [ -n "$TEST_NOTES" ]; then asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds test-notes create --build-id "${steps.resolve_existing_build.BUILD_ID}" --locale "$LOCALE" --whats-new "$TEST_NOTES" || asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds test-notes update --build-id "${steps.resolve_existing_build.BUILD_ID}" --locale "$LOCALE" --whats-new "$TEST_NOTES"; else echo 'Skipping TestFlight notes because TEST_NOTES is empty.' >&2; fi

steps.name: distribute
steps.run: if [ -n "$TESTFLIGHT_GROUP_ID" ]; then asc --profile $ASC_PROFILE builds add-groups --build-id "${steps.resolve_existing_build.BUILD_ID}" --group "$TESTFLIGHT_GROUP_ID"; else echo 'Skipping TestFlight group distribution because TESTFLIGHT_GROUP_ID is empty.' >&2; fi
